h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mysore

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mysore

items.pText: Mysore is a city of palaces, wide avenues and old public gardens, and buyers here often care how a playground looks as much as how it plays. A school with heritage buildings, a hotel near the palace or a society in one of the quieter layouts does not want a plastic block that clashes with everything around it. We are asked about colour, form and material more often in Mysore than in many larger cities.

FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment at our own factory in Vasai, about 880 km away. We can pick from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, offer wooden and composite structures in some ranges, and customise designs on request. Share photos of the site and its surroundings, the age group of the children and the space you have. We will suggest pieces that suit the setting and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Matching a playground to a garden setting

c: Where the setting is green and formal, softer colours such as greens, browns and creams sit better than a full rainbow. Our
have a natural look that suits older gardens and resort lawns. The
from Funplay Originals takes its shapes from nature and fits a garden without looking out of place.

Mysore's climate is milder than most of the Deccan, but the summer sun and the monsoon still reach the equipment. Benches and a gazebo near the play area give parents somewhere to sit, and they help the playground read as part of the garden.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 880 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you match playground colours to our building or garden in Mysore?
items.a: Yes. We have more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, and we can suggest a combination that suits your building and planting. Send us photos of the site and we will propose colours along with the layout.

items.q: Do you make wooden playground equipment?
items.a: Some of our ranges use wooden and composite materials, including the NexLev Woody structures. We can show you options that suit a heritage or garden setting.

items.q: How does equipment reach Mysore from your factory?
items.a: We dispatch it by road from Vasai. Our installation team or a dealer in south India then installs it on a self-standing base or by grouting, depending on your ground.
